## Why

slicer s460 bumps RELAY_CONTRACT from 12 to 13. The v13 rule: when the orchestrator is a program, it may run the closing note and the finish step itself after VERDICT: PASS, using the note text from the Outcome: line in the implementer's last report; the implementer writes Outcome: and runs neither command. When the orchestrator is an agent, the implementer still runs both steps. Order, report shape and gate are unchanged. slicer ai relay --json carries the rule in its obligations. This puts ork adj 407 (engine.finish-runner) into the contract. Today ork accepts only v11/v12 (ork projects pin help), and slicer on PATH is the slicer main checkout, so landing s460 before ork accepts v13 would break every ork project's relays, as s453 (v12) did on 2026-11-12. s460 runs with --stop-after commit (run ork-20261118-130321-4cea) and lands only after this item: accept v13 in the contract check, doctor and pins, (S384 then runs the finish step in the engine from the Outcome: line).

Evidence (2026-11-18):

- ork's accepted set is `acceptedContracts = []int{11, 12}` (`internal/roles/roles.go:113-116`, adj 326 `boundary.contract-set`), and `CheckContractLine` refuses any other version (`internal/roles/roles.go:131-144`). The engine, `ork doctor` and `ork projects pin --relay N` all go through it (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:75-80`, `internal/cli/doctor.go:252,294`, `internal/cli/pin.go:67`).
- The s460 branch (slicer `6cfb5c18`) sets `RELAY_CONTRACT = 13` (`slicer/src/slicer/ai.py:259` on that branch), adds the `RELAY_CHANGES` entry for 13, and adds the Conformance obligation `finish_runner` after `finish_after_pass`. The rule says a program orchestrator "may" run both steps; the implementer runs neither only when the program does run them. So an ork that accepts v13 and still resumes the implementer for the finish step (`internal/engine/states.go:1308-1340`) is conformant.
- `slicer ai relay --json` from the s460 branch prints `"contract": "relay v13"` and the `finish_runner` conformance entry (read-only run on 2026-11-18 with `PYTHONPATH` set to the s460 worktree's `src`).
- Validate requires a fixed list of conformance keys (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:91`) and v12's `tool_feedback` key from v12 on (`internal/slicercli/contract.go:110-113`).

Owner decisions (2026-11-18, interactive, relay session 8d711f67):

- adj 470 `boundary.contract-set` (supersedes adj 326): ork accepts v12 and v13, and the role prompts move to v13. v11 is refused, as S354 did for v10.
- adj 471 `scope.v13-finish-slice`: this slice only accepts v13. S384 makes the engine run the finish step.
